header.running_head: Exercising Caution when Issuing Fataawaa and the Sahabah (RA) who used to Issue Fataawaa

blocks.text: Statements of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA), Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "It is only a madman who will immediately issue a Fatwa for everything he is asked." The same statement has been reported from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA). [^1]

Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) said, "It is only one of three persons who would issue Fataawaa; a man who knows which verses of the Qur'aan abrogate injunctions of Deen and which have been abrogated, a leader who has no alternative and a pretentious fool." [^2]

Hadhrat Ibn Seereen narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to Hadhrat Abu Mas'ood Uqba bin Umar (RA), "I was informed that you issue Fataawaa to people! The person blessed with the privileges (of leadership) should also bear its burden (of issuing Fataawaa)." [^3] Another narration states that Hadhrat Umar (RA) also added, "And you are not a governor (so you need not issue Fataawaa)." [^4]
The Cautiousness of Hadhrat Zaid bin Arqam and Hadhrat Baraa (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Abu Minhaal says, "When I questioned Hadhrat Zaid bin Arqam (RA) and Hadhrat Baraa (RA) about selling gold and silver, each one of them told me to ask the other, saying, 'He is better than me and has more knowledge.'" The narration goes on further to discuss trading in gold and silver. [^5]

Hadhrat Abu Husayn says, "Everyone now issues Fataawaa on matters that had they been posed to Hadhrat Umar (RA), he would have gathered all the veterans of Badr (to consult with before issuing a Fatwaa)." [^6]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) and Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) Issue Fataawaa During the Time of Rasulullaah ﷺ
When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) was asked who used to issue Fataawaa during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ, he replied, "Abu Bakr (RA) and Umar (RA). I do not know of anyone else." [^7]
